Card Q&A.a: This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.  It can't trash a DUAL card that is treated as a Digimon through digivolution or other card in the battle area other than one placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  If your opponent has Digimon, you must choose the card with the lowest DP among them and delete it.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has a Digimon.  Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by not choosing a card to delete?

My opponent has a Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion.  Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by choosing an opponent's Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?
This card is linked to a Digimon.  If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can link it.  Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.
Card Q&A.q: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card.  Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?

I used BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to use this card, and I used its [Main] effect to link this card to my Digimon.  If I then use the part of BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect after "then" to have the linked Digimon attack, can I activate this card's link effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.  However, a Digimon without DP won't be considered to have DP from link DP.
